channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Geaney and Dingle ready to fulfil Croker dream
item.description: Reaching the All-Ireland club SFC final was something Dingle had been plotting since 2018, according to captain Paul Geaney.

item.title: Kerry include All-Ireland winning quartet for season opener
item.description: The Kerry team to face Clare in this evening's McGrath Cup opener at Clarecastle includes four players who featured in last year's All-Ireland SFC final victory over Donegal.

item.title: St Brigid's sweating on injured duo
item.description: Brian Stack and Mark Daly are facing a race against time to be fit for St Brigid's All-Ireland club SFC final showdown with Dingle on Sunday week.

item.title: DCU open Sigerson Cup defence against Ulster University
item.description: The 2026 Sigerson Cup gets underway today with four first round ties down for decision.

item.title: Donnelly eager to assist Tyrone's next generation
item.description: Mattie Donnelly is keen to help Tyrone's up-and-coming football stars after committing to the cause for a 17th season.

item.title: Galway planning without key trio as Conroy recommits
item.description: Young Footballer of the Year nominee Matthew Thompson will miss Galway's upcoming Allianz League campaign.

item.title: 'It appears that we will finally be entering the delivery phase'
item.description: The long-awaited redevelopment of Casement Park is finally set to commence this year.

item.title: UL begin Fitzgibbon Cup defence against Maynooth
item.description: The 2026 Fitzgibbon Cup commences today with two games taking place.

item.title: 'It would have been silly not to ask him in'
item.description: Andy Moran has hailed Kobe McDonald as a 'hyper-talented boy' after including him in his Mayo football squad.

item.title: O'Connor gets green light to play in All-Ireland club final
item.description: Dingle have been handed a huge boost with the news that Mark O'Connor has been granted permission by Geelong to line out in Sunday week's All-Ireland club SFC final against St Brigid's.
